basic_info.description: Graceful and stylish, this reimagined Doelger home was fully remodeled in 2020 offering a rare chance to own an architectural gem in the Westlake District. Designed for modern living, this sunlit 3BR and 3BA residence features nearly 2,000 sq ft of open-concept living space with curated finishes and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Set behind a beautifully paved driveway, the home welcomes you with striking curb appeal, soaring ceilings, and wood floors throughout. At the heart is a stunning entertainer's kitchen with a dramatic quartz island, flanked by moving glass walls that open to a private deck and expansive landscaped yard. The open living room features a gas fireplace, skylight, and oversized windows for timeless gatherings. The luxurious primary suite offers an impressive walk-in closet and spa-like bath with dual vanities and soaking tub overlooking the tranquil garden. The 2nd and 3rd brs are generous in size with natural light, a designer bath and laundry closet on this level.  A lower-level office or guest suite with French doors to the garden & full bath adds flexible living space. Garage includes EV charging and storage, plus a driveway for 2 more cars. Located near Westlake Shopping Center, BART, and 280, this home blends architectural integrity with modern comfort.
